title: Content path handout
subtitle: Problem → prompt → AI tool. Paste and work.
modalityChecklist: Image – paste the prompt into an image tool (Midjourney, ChatGPT, or similar).
Video – turn the keyframe into a 3–5 s clip in a video tool.
Audio – voice or bed in an audio tool; one line on rights.
Edit – join the pieces in an edit tool (CapCut or similar).
imagePromptTemplate:
Brief: goal [Awareness / Engagement / Conversion], audience [who], platform [where].
Create a hero image: [SUBJECT and action], setting [CONTEXT], style [STYLE], ratio [1:1 / 16:9 / 9:16].
Brand: colors [X], tone [professional / friendly / premium]. No text in the image unless needed.
Style lock (do not rewrite): [15+ words]. Model for this series: [one].
Rights: check that the tool allows public use.
videoPromptTemplate:
Start: keyframe. What does not change: [product / label / colors]. The subject does: [one verb]. Camera: [one move]. 3 s first. Last frame: label readable, no new objects.
Rights: same frame, same style – do not change other people's marks.
musicPromptTemplate:
Role: [who they speak to]. Tone: [warm / calm]. Keep the same tempo. Glossary: [brand] = [how to say it]. 3 lines: hook / benefit / ask. Bed after the voice, no vocal. License: commercial.
Rights: can you use it publicly?
montagePromptTemplate:
Edit plan (15–30 s):
0–3 s: [hook]
3–8 s: [product / benefit]
8–15 s: [detail]
End: [CTA]
Audio: [voice / bed] | rights: [licensed]
AI label: made with [tool].
rightsChecklist: Next to each prompt – one line: can you use it publicly?
deliveryChecklist: At least one prompt and a result or link.
If you joined the pieces – video + audio + edit.
One lock card: model · style header · refs · voice · rights · AI label.
reflectionSummary: Within 24–48 hours, use one prompt in a real project. Write what worked, what you changed, and whether rights are clear.
nextPageIntro: The path is done when you have not just a result, but a prompt you can paste again.
